title: File:ReceiptSwiss.jpg
note: German, but "Chässpätzli" is Swiss German for cheese spätzle. Prices in CHF, VAT at 7.6% (Switzerland's rate in 2007) and a euro conversion for tourists. The hotel sits on a mountain pass under the Wetterhorn, two hours' walk above Grindelwald.

title: File:GRC — Region Südliche Ägäis — Regionalbezirk Rhodos — Gemeinde Rhodos — Ialyssos-Ixia — 1 Iliadon Str. (Dionysos Hotel · Quittung für die Zahlung der Übernachtungstaxe) Mattes 2022-10-05.jpg

answer.place: Dionysos Hotel, Iliadon St, Ixia, Rhodes

note: Greek letters with English underneath: a receipt for the per-night accommodation tax Greek hotels charge. Ixia is the hotel strip on the west coast of Rhodes, the island closest to Turkey in the Dodecanese.

title: File:KFC Xitun Carrefour Restaurant e-invoice ED64052745.jpg

answer.place: KFC, Carrefour Xitun, Taiwan Boulevard, Taichung

note: Traditional Chinese characters (not the simplified ones used in mainland China) and the date "109年": year 109 of the Republic of China calendar, used only in Taiwan (it's 2020). The "電子發票" e-invoice with a lottery number is a Taiwanese institution, and the store code starts TWI.

title: File:Чек Сільпо Чернігів 20211217.jpg
note: Ukrainian, not Russian: the letters і and ї, "ГРН" (hryvnia), 20% ПДВ and PrivatBank. Silpo prints a horoscope-style "prediction" on every receipt; this one says guests may drop by in the evening. Chernihiv is north of Kyiv, near the Belarus border.

title: File:Alves receipt (2019) 01.jpg
note: Prices in FL, the Netherlands Antillean guilder, which only Curaçao and Sint Maarten still use. English item names, a US-style date, 6% sales tax, and the sign-off "Masha danki pa bo kompra!": Papiamentu for "thank you for your purchase".

title: File:네이버 MY플레이스 영수증 인증 화면.png
note: Hangul and prices in 원 (won). It's a screenshot from Naver's receipt-check app, showing a Daiso haul of Disney keyrings and postcards. Wonju is in Gangwon Province, about 90 minutes east of Seoul.

title: File:Paragon fiskalny - 2024.08.02.jpg
note: "Paragon fiskalny", "SUMA PLN" and VAT (PTU) at 23% and 5% are all Polish. Biedronka ("ladybird") is Poland's biggest supermarket chain. Kamienna Góra is in Lower Silesia, a few kilometres from the Czech border.

title: File:麦当劳小票订单号39581 (202411141911).jpg
note: Simplified Chinese, so mainland China rather than Taiwan or Hong Kong, and a ¥9.90 mint-chocolate drink ordered through the McDonald's app. The restaurant is at Tianbao metro station in Dongguan, the factory city between Guangzhou and Shenzhen.

title: File:Grocery Store Receipt in Vienna.jpg
note: German, but the 10% VAT on food is Austrian (Germany's is 7%). The shop's name, blacked out, was Hofer: what Aldi Süd is called in Austria. This one is next to Vienna's main station.

title: File:Pink Peacock receipt.jpg

answer.place: Pink Peacock café, 451 Victoria Road, Govanhill, Glasgow

note: Handwritten prices in pounds, a bagel-and-cream-cheese order, and Yiddish in Hebrew letters next to English. Pink Peacock was a queer, Yiddish, pay-what-you-can café in Govanhill, Glasgow's most diverse neighbourhood.

title: File:Receipt from BCA payment terminal in South Tangerang, Indonesia (2025-08-28).jpg

answer.place: Jl. Sumatera, Villa Bintaro Indah, South Tangerang

note: "Rp." is the Indonesian rupiah, BCA is Bank Central Asia (Indonesia's biggest private bank) and "TUNAI" is Indonesian for cash. Bintaro is a suburb on the south-west edge of Jakarta.

title: File:Кассовый чек выданный при покупке в магазине DNS в России.jpg

answer.place: DNS, Vavilon mall, Kosmonavtov Ave, Rostov-on-Don

note: Cyrillic, prices in roubles (Руб) and 20% НДС (VAT), plus the paperwork of Russia's online-till law (ОФД, ФН, ИНН). DNS is a Russian electronics chain; this branch is in the Vavilon mall in Rostov-on-Don, near the Sea of Azov.

title: File:Účtenka Čtyřkoly.jpg

answer.place: Penzion a restaurace U Čerta, Čtyřkoly

note: Czech: "nakládaný hermelín" is pickled Czech camembert, a classic pub snack. Prices in Kč with a euro conversion, and 21% DPH (VAT). Čtyřkoly is a village on the Sázava river, south-east of Prague.

title: File:Lidl Emsstraße receipt, Aurich (2019) 01.jpg
note: German item names, "zu zahlen" and a Maestro card payment, then the clincher: VAT at 7% and 19%, Germany's two rates. Aurich is in East Frisia, near the North Sea and the Dutch border.

title: File:HK Sheung Wan 喜悅海鮮酒家 Hei Yuet Seafood Restaurant Official Receipt in pink Paid chop print May-2010.jpg

answer.place: Hei Yuet Palace Restaurant, 267–275 Des Voeux Road Central, Sheung Wan

note: Traditional Chinese with English alongside (a colonial-era habit), "港幣" and "H.K. Dollars". The restaurant was in Sheung Wan, on Hong Kong Island's tram line.

title: File:CHE — GR — Region Engiadina Bassa Val Müstair — Gde. Zernez — Punt la Drossa (Munt la Schera-Tunnel · Quittung) 2024-07-18 Mattes.jpg

answer.place: Munt la Schera tunnel toll, Punt la Drossa, Zernez

note: German with an Italian line ("Termini di utilizzo"), CHF and 8.1% VAT, Switzerland's rate since 2024. It's the motorbike toll for the single-lane Munt la Schera tunnel, which leads from the Engadine into duty-free Livigno, Italy.

title: File:Mautstrasse Hinterriss ↔ Eng (Quittung 2020).jpeg
note: German, €3.50 and a legal citation to the "LGBl.", the state law gazette Austria uses. It's a motorbike toll for the private road from Hinterriß to the Eng, an alpine meadow in the Karwendel mountains of Tyrol that you can only reach from Germany.
